title: fix(plugin-approvals): a user approver naming no account expands to nobody and takes onEmptyApprovers
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_
Fixes #27397

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` text describes a `user` approver's resolution; the one docs page that did (`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, two sentences that this change makes false) is corrected here

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`user` 类型审批人现在会先查目录（`sys_user`，按 id 或邮箱）。查不到这个账号时，它和部门、团队、岗位这些图类型一样：打同一条 `expanded to nobody` 警告，不占槽位。名单因此变空时，走节点的 `onEmptyApprovers`，默认是 `admin_rescue`。
- **为什么改**：以前写错的用户 id，或者已经删掉的账号，会作为一个谁都处理不了的幽灵槽位开出审批单。没有日志，也没有转交管理员，这张单子会永远挂着。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只有 `sys_user` 读成功、而且确实没有这一行时才丢槽位：读失败时保留原槽位；被封禁的账号、别的组织目录里的人、以及 OOO 委托到真实代理人的情况都不变。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` 的 `resolveApproverSpec` 里 `type === 'user'` 分支和共用的警告分支；`admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts` 新增的 describe；`approval-service.test.ts` 的 `ROUTED_USERS` 与 `putAccounts`（夹具改动）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts`，预期 22/22 通过，其中包含 "a `user` approver naming no user expands to nobody" 这一组。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The `user` approver branch** in `resolveApproverSpec`. A `user` value is now asked of the directory through the predicate the reassign door already uses (`reassignTargetRefusal`). That predicate looks for a `sys_user` row carrying the id, or the email for an email-shaped value. It is asked with no organization, so its tenancy screen does not run: `user` is directory-less, and ADR-0105 D9 leaves it untouched (the existing `approver-cross-org` pin holds that). When no account carries the value, the branch falls through to the graph types' existing warning (same text, now reached for `user` too) and returns no slot. A slate it leaves empty reaches the node's `onEmptyApprovers` by the existing path; there is no new branch and no new warning text.
- **What counts as "no such user"**: a successful `sys_user` read that returns no row. These cases still keep the slot:
  - a **banned** account. The team and department expansions do not read the flag either; I measured this on `expandTeamUsers` and `expandBusinessUnitUsers`.
  - a **failed read**. A failed read proves nothing, which is this file's fail-open posture on addressing paths. A new unit pin covers it.
  - a value spelled as a `TYPE:VALUE` literal. `slateNamesAPerson` already reads that as naming no one.
- **Checked after OOO delegation**: the check asks about the slot the route ends on. A removed account whose out-of-office delegation names a live delegate still routes to the delegate (the existing #24065 notification-body pin).
- **A mixed slate** (one real user plus one phantom) keeps the real one, drops only the phantom, and logs the warning once for the phantom. That is the same per-entry warning a graph entry beside a person logs.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` said that a `user` entry never resolves to nobody. Two sentences are corrected.
- **Fixtures**: the unit doubles started with an empty `sys_user`, so every `user` approver in them was a phantom by the new rule. They now start with the accounts each suite routes to (`ROUTED_USERS`, plus `putAccounts` where a test writes a named row). Three dogfood fixtures used an address deliberately carried by no account: `CO_APPROVER` (two of them) and `DEPARTED_APPROVER`. Each pin now signs that address up as an account that never acts, so the scene each pin measures is unchanged. The test-typecheck ledger shrinks by two, because a replaced test took two pre-existing errors with it.

## Tests

The PIN is through the real `ApprovalService.openNodeRequest` on a real ObjectQL plus SqlDriver, with real administrators. It is a new describe in `admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts`:

- a `user` approver naming `usr_does_not_exist` takes the default `admin_rescue` route. The request opens on `u_admin` and `u_owner`, and they are told. `approver 'user:usr_does_not_exist' expanded to nobody` is logged once, and the routing line is logged once. `pending_approvers` holds no `usr_does_not_exist`, and `admin_rescue:abandoned` is `[]`.
- a mixed list `[u_alice, usr_does_not_exist]` opens on `['u_alice']` alone, with the phantom's warning logged once and no administrator routing.
- an email that no account carries is dropped. An email that an account carries keeps its slot.
- CONTROL: a real user keeps the slot, with no expanded-to-nobody line. A person of another organization's directory keeps the slot too (ADR-0105 D9).

The unit pins are in `approval-service.test.ts`. The old "stays quiet for `user`" test, which pinned the phantom slot, is replaced by three tests:
- the warning and its meta, with no slot;
- a control in which a real account stays quiet;
- a failed `sys_user` read keeps the slot.

<details><summary>Red first, then green</summary>

Before the fix, the new describe at base `a75ddba1` gave 4 failed and 17 passed (21):
`expected [ 'usr_does_not_exist' ] to deeply equal [ 'u_admin', 'u_owner' ]` · `expected [ 'u_alice', 'usr_does_not_exist' ] to deeply equal [ 'u_alice' ]` · the email leg · (and the other-org leg, which was later turned into the D9 control).

At final head ``10a61cc4``, with the closure rebuilt after the `origin/main` merge, the run under the verify lock gave:
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run`: Test Files 105 passed (105), Tests 1338 passed (1338).
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK` (8 files / 321 errors / 27 pinned signatures).
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance exec vitest run src/hono-approvals-act.conformance.test.ts`: 4/4. It covers an unregistered `sys_user`: the read throws and the slot is kept.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the suite reads src, so no dist leg)</summary>

1. `if (refusal === undefined) return routed;` was replaced with `return routed;`, which removes the existence check. Result: 4 failed and 405 passed (409). The failures were the three integration legs and the unit warning pin, for example `expected [ 'usr_does_not_exist' ] to deeply equal [ 'u_admin', 'u_owner' ]`. The controls stayed green. The restore was checked: blob `ae44df7ffede` == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
2. `if (GRAPH_APPROVER_TYPES.has(type) || type === 'user') {` was replaced with `if (GRAPH_APPROVER_TYPES.has(type)) {`, which removes the shared warning. Result: 3 failed and 406 passed (409): `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0` (twice) and `no warning for user: expected undefined to be truthy`. The restore was checked: blob == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, and not fixed here: `type: 'field'` has the same unchecked shape. A record field holding a user id that no account carries opens a phantom slot in the same way (`resolveApproverSpec`, the `field` branch, `csvSplit(record[value])` straight to `applyOooDelegation`). Not filed by this PR; it is named in the report for the seat.
- Out of scope, and not fixed here: a delegation's `delegate_id` is not existence-checked either. An OOO hop to a removed account would open a phantom slot the same way. Noted, not filed.
- `examples/app-showcase` `approver-bindings.flow.ts` carries `{ type: 'user', value: '' }` on an `obsolete` flow. If that flow ever runs, it now logs `approver 'user:' expanded to nobody`, where before it was silent. The empty slot was already dropped before this change.
- The dogfood battery does not run on pull requests (its `if:` excludes them), so the dogfood fixture edits are verified by the local run below, not by CI on this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates on `10a61cc4`</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 94 command(s) on `10a61cc4`. I ran every one at that head and captured each exit code before any pipe: **94/94 exit 0**.

`dispatch-gates --ran`: `Run reconciliation — 94 derived, 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` · `a DERIVED zero — all 94 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3`.

I also ran these locally, outside the derived set:
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` and the six dogfood files: exit 0.
- the package test suite and typecheck (above).
- the http-conformance approvals pin.
- the nine approval dogfood files that open `user` approvers (override-composite, my-pending-position, position-address-readers, admin-rescue-slate, notification-body, pending-approver-record-read, record-lock-read, sla-reassign-target-resolves, seed-ownership-claim-dispatch). Run under the verify lock after building the dogfood closure: Test Files 9 passed (9), Tests 9 passed (9).

`merge-tree` against the three open PRs that touch `packages/qa/dogfood/test/` (#27713, #27667, #27649) shows no conflict on any file this PR changes.
</details>
